faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Libya B2B
faq.answer1: Libya B2B is the first B2B e-commerce platform designed specifically for Libyan businesses. It connects suppliers and buyers across the country, enabling efficient trade with features like offline access, Arabic chatbot support, and Cash on Delivery.
faq.question2: How do I place an order?
faq.answer2: Browse products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Choose Cash on Delivery as your payment method and confirm your order. You can track your order using QR codes.
faq.answer3: We currently accept Cash on Delivery (COD) only. This means you pay when your order is delivered, with no risk of online payment fraud.
faq.question4: How do I track my order?
faq.answer4: Use the tracking page with your order number or scan the QR code on your delivery receipt. You can see real-time updates on your order status.
faq.answer5: A Supplier is a verified Libyan business that sells products on the platform. All suppliers are authenticated and verified for safe trading.
faq.question6: How do I create an account?
faq.answer6: Click 'My Account' in the navigation bar and register with your business details. You can register as a Buyer or Seller depending on your needs.
faq.answer7: Request for Quotation (RFQ) allows you to send inquiries to suppliers for bulk orders. You can specify quantities, requirements, and receive competitive quotes.
faq.answer8: Get discounts when ordering larger quantities. Prices automatically adjust based on quantity tiers (10+, 50+, 100+ units).
faq.answer9: Our AI chatbot answers questions about products and pricing in Arabic. It can help you find products, compare prices, and place orders.
faq.answer10: Yes, the platform works offline and syncs when connected. You can browse products, view orders, and access previously loaded data without an internet connection.
faq.meta_description: Frequently asked questions about Libya B2B Platform. Registration, orders, payments, and support.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1_content: By using Libya B2B, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use the platform. These terms apply to all users of the platform, including buyers and suppliers.
terms.section2_content: You must provide accurate and complete business information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.section3_content: Orders are placed via the platform with Cash on Delivery as the default payment method. All orders are subject to product availability and supplier confirmation. Prices listed on the platform are subject to change without notice.
terms.section4_content: Payment is made upon delivery (Cash on Delivery). The full order amount must be paid at the time of delivery. No partial payments or installments are accepted unless explicitly agreed upon with the supplier.
terms.section5_content: Delivery times vary by location and product availability. Estimated delivery dates are provided at checkout but are not guaranteed. Libya B2B is not liable for delays caused by logistics partners or unforeseen circumstances.
terms.section6_content: Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for defective or incorrect items. Items must be in their original condition and packaging. Contact the supplier through the messaging platform to initiate a return.
terms.section7_content: Libya B2B acts as a marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers. We are not liable for product quality, safety, or compliance issues. All disputes should be resolved between the buyer and supplier.
terms.section8_content: Disputes are resolved through our support team. Contact us via the messaging platform with your order details and we will mediate between both parties to reach a fair resolution.
terms.meta_description: Terms of Service for Libya B2B Platform. User agreements, policies, and conditions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_content: We collect business information necessary for account creation and order processing. This includes business name, contact details, and delivery addresses. We do not collect personal information beyond what is required for platform functionality.
privacy.section2_content: Data is used solely to provide platform services, process orders, and communicate with users. We do not use your data for marketing purposes without explicit consent. All data processing complies with Libyan data protection regulations.
privacy.section3_content: Data is stored securely on our servers using industry-standard encryption. We implement appropriate security measures to protect against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction of data. Data is retained only as long as necessary for platform operations.
privacy.section4_content: We do not share your data with third parties except as necessary to complete orders (e.g., sharing delivery address with logistics partners). All third parties are contractually obligated to protect your information.
privacy.section5_content: We use essential cookies for platform functionality and session management. These cookies are necessary for the platform to work correctly. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.section6_content: You can request data deletion at any time by contacting our support team. You also have the right to access, correct, or export your data. We will respond to all data requests within 30 days.
privacy.meta_description: Privacy Policy for Libya B2B Platform. Data protection and user privacy information.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.section1_content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the platform remember your preferences and session information. Cookies do not contain personal information and cannot harm your device.
cookie.section2_content: We use essential cookies for authentication, session management, and platform functionality. These cookies are strictly necessary for the platform to work. Without them, you would need to re-login on every page.
cookie.section3_content: You can manage cookies in your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, blocking essential cookies may prevent the platform from functioning correctly.
cookie.section4_content: We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies. The only cookies used are those necessary for Libya B2B platform functionality. We do not sell or share cookie data with advertisers.
cookie.section5_content: If you have any questions about our cookie policy, please contact us through the messaging platform. Our support team will respond within 24 hours.
cookie.meta_description: Cookie Policy for Libya B2B Platform. How we use cookies and tracking technologies.

about.title: About Libya B2B
about.subtitle: Building the future of B2B trade in Libya
about.section1_content: Libya B2B is the first B2B e-commerce platform designed specifically for Libyan businesses. We connect suppliers and buyers across the country, enabling efficient trade with modern technology. Our platform supports both online and offline operations, making it accessible even in areas with limited internet connectivity.
about.section2_content: To connect Libyan suppliers and buyers through a modern, reliable, and accessible platform. We aim to simplify B2B trade by providing tools for product discovery, price negotiation, order management, and delivery tracking. Our goal is to boost economic activity and support local businesses.
about.section3_content: A dedicated team of developers, business experts, and logistics specialists working together to build Libya's first B2B platform. Our team combines technical expertise with deep understanding of local business needs to create a platform that truly serves the Libyan market.
about.section4_content: Reach out to us via the messaging platform for any inquiries, partnership opportunities, or support requests. We are committed to providing excellent service and responding to all inquiries within 24 hours.
about.meta_description: About Libya B2B Platform. Our mission to connect Libyan businesses through digital trade.

careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: Join our team and help build Libya's B2B future
careers.section1_content: Join an innovative team building Libya's first B2B platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where your ideas matter. Work on challenging problems, learn new technologies, and make a real impact on how Libyan businesses trade. We value creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.
careers.section2_content: We are always looking for talented developers, business experts, and logistics specialists. Whether you're experienced or just starting your career, we have opportunities for passionate individuals who want to make a difference in the Libyan B2B market.
careers.section3_content: Send your CV and a brief cover letter to our HR team via the messaging platform. We review all applications within one week and will contact you for an initial screening call if your profile matches our requirements.
careers.meta_description: Career opportunities at Libya B2B Platform. Join our team and help build Libya's digital economy.
